meta.extractedFrom: xlsx export of the page (per-level rows recovered from the flattened text cell of each tech) + the saved HTML for names, categories, icons and power
meta.granularity: per level — levels[].* is the cost of that single level; totals[] is their sum
meta.roundingNote: The source abbreviates the bulk resources on screen (7K, 1.1M) so gold/bread/wood/stone/iron carry up to ~0.5% error; levels[].raw keeps their original text so the precision is visible. Dust, Tempered Truegold and time print in full and are EXACT — and they are what actually gates this tree.
meta.effectNote: effectTotal is the cumulative bonus once the level is done (the source displays it that way); effectDelta is the gain of that level alone. Unit is given by effectUnit.
meta.powerNote: Power exists only as a per-tech total in the source; there is no per-level power figure.
missing: French names and effect labels — this update has not reached the player's game server yet (estimated ~50 days from 2026-08-09), so the official FR strings do not exist anywhere. Keep FR null until they can be read in-game; do NOT invent or machine-translate them.
meta.legend: TG1 to TG8 is your War Academy's Truegold tier. TTG: Tempered Truegold. Dust: Truegold Dust.
meta.note: Companion to truegold_war_db.json (the Basic tree). Not wired into any calculator yet.

effect.EN: Chance of obtaining 1 extra Truegold from Beast Hunting missions.
